page.title: Agents
page.subtitle: Build, test and publish chat agents for {{workspace}}

empty.title: No assistants yet
empty.description: Pick a ready-made agent and make it yours, or build your own flow from scratch: add steps, test it in the simulator and publish.
empty.templatesKicker: Or start from a complete agent

list.label: Agents
list.error: The agents could not be loaded.

noMatch.title: No agents match
noMatch.description: Try another search or clear the filters.

pause.title: Pause {{name}}?
pause.intro: The agent stops running its flow. Scheduled follow-ups and external events are skipped while it is paused.
pause.modeInbox: Go to the Inbox as “Needs you”
pause.modeAway: Get an away message, nobody is notified

issue.required: Write the away message the customer will receive.
issue.tooLong: The away message is too long. Use up to {{max}} characters.

pause.resumeNote: Resume any time from the same menu. The live version (v{{version}}) stays as it is.

gallery.title: Start a new agent
gallery.description: Pick a template or an example, or begin with an empty flow.

blank.title: Blank flow
blank.description: Start from an empty canvas and add the steps yourself.

intro.templates: Small agents that fit any business. Pick one, name it, upload your files to its knowledge base and tune the prompts.
intro.examples: Complete agents for a café and an online store. Run them as they are, or see how many steps and agents work together.
intro.snippets: Small flows that each show one idea. Start from one, or learn the pattern and reuse it.
intro.blank: Start from an empty canvas when you already know the flow you want.

detail.description: See what you get, name your agent and create it.
detail.nameHint: You can rename it any time.
detail.draftNote: The agent is created as a draft. Nothing goes live until you publish it.

knowledge.label: Knowledge bases
knowledge.none: You have no knowledge bases yet. You can attach one later in the Agent step.

createNew.description_one: It starts empty. Upload your files to it after you create the agent.
createNew.description_other: One for each agent. They start empty: upload your files after you create the agent.

useExisting.title: Use existing knowledge bases
useExisting.description: Every agent answers from the bases you choose. You can change this later in each Agent step.

knowledge.created_one: An empty knowledge base was created. Upload your files so the agent can answer from them.
knowledge.created_other: {{count}} empty knowledge bases were created. Upload your files so the agents can answer from them.
